refnamediv.refpurpose: Copy a cURL handle along with all of its preferences

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
CurlHandlefalsecurl_copy_handle CurlHandlehandle
Copies a cURL handle keeping the same preferences.
The cookies that the handle received during previous transfers and the share set with CURLOPT_SHARE are not carried over to the copy. Streams set with CURLOPT_FILE, CURLOPT_WRITEHEADER and CURLOPT_INFILE are shared with the original, not duplicated.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns a new cURL handle, &return.falseforfailure;. An E_WARNING is emitted when &false; is returned, for example if the handle holds a CURLFile that is no longer allowed by open_basedir.
